items.heading: Bandeja Paisa
details: Key ingredients: beans, rice, ground beef, chorizo, plantain, egg, avocado
Cook a pot of red beans until tender.
Grill or fry ground beef, chorizo and a fried egg.
Fry sweet plantain slices until caramelized.
Arrange rice, beans, meats, plantain, egg and avocado together on one large plate.

items.heading: Arepas
details: Key ingredients: corn flour, water, salt, cheese (optional)
Mix precooked corn flour with warm water and salt into a soft dough.
Shape the dough into flat, round discs.
Cook on a hot griddle until lightly charred on both sides.
Split and fill with cheese or serve alongside other dishes.
